Read-only exact-SHA review of WeightedCoverage measured three public carriers in align/signature.scala with the same method name but different grains: WeightedCoverage.support is leaf-count coverage; MassRatio.support is conditioning-mass fraction; StepMass.support is comparable-step count fraction. Each calculation is locally correct and documented, so this is not a blocker for bd-01M17466HSR8A41TP6TSQ23WM4. Risk: call sites comparing x.support across carriers cannot see whether the returned quantity is count or mass. Chief should decide whether grain-specific accessor names or a typed support vocabulary are warranted. No edit, claim, or reservation.
